name: Accessibility Attribute Regression Guard
summary: Block net removal of explicit accessibility relationships from markup changes.
description: Parses bounded markup and rejects three changes: one that drops an accessible name, role, or relationship from a retained element; one that hides a focusable element from assistive technology while it still takes keyboard focus; and one that stops the browser zooming.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks net removal of explicit accessibility relationships from markup changes; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not judge whether a name or role is accurate, only whether the change removed one that was there.
It does not see a focusable child inside a hidden wrapper, and it judges an element with no id, test id or name by how many of its kind still carry a name or relationship rather than by position.
It does not read a viewport value the page computes at runtime, and it does not measure rendered text size or reflow.
It does not report a problem the inspected edit did not introduce, and it does not claim accessibility conformance.

entrypoints.purpose: Block net removal of explicit accessibility relationships from markup changes.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block net removal of explicit accessibility relationships from markup changes without deferred work.
